text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 15, 2022) for 787 Jane Street.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Deferred consideration of the Property Standards Order (August 15, 2022) for 787 Jane Street, Folder No. 22 189978 PRS 00 IV to its meeting on November 22, 2022. 2. Directed the Appellant to work with the Municipal Standards Officer to ensure immediate health and safety requirements are properly secured for the property during this time.
